purpose: Use governed existing translations and mappings to generate, triangulate, diagnose, and prioritize HPO translation candidates without treating availability, mapping reachability, or source count as validity or permission.

current_study_scope.expansion_rule: Any added language, source payload, route, candidate condition, sampling rule, or analysis requires a new prospective freeze before empirical use.

eligible_sources: authorized versioned terminology editions with exact language or regional identity
predicate-aware mapped disease, clinical, and classification sources
PATO, Uberon, Cell Ontology, uPheno, MP and other governed component mappings
UMLS, MedGen, Mondo and other lineage-preserving aggregators

stages.name: metadata_feasibility
stages.exit_rule: every proposed use has a role, exact endpoint, disposition, and gate state

stages.name: authorization_and_freeze
stages.entry_gate: accountable source, language, community, ethics and privacy decisions
stages.exit_rule: all selected payloads, versions, purposes, custody rules, and exclusions are frozen

stages.name: source_atom_generation
stages.exit_rule: every atom has source ID, concept ID, language tag, object type, release, route, rights state, derivation path, and lineage group

stages.name: candidate_construction
stages.entry_gate: candidate condition and leakage controls frozen
stages.exit_rule: reference translations are withheld and no candidate exceeds its weakest route or rights state

stages.name: isolated_agent_panel_assessment
stages.exit_rule: all required roles complete or prespecified revise/stop rule applies

stages.name: comparative_analysis
stages.entry_gate: outcomes and exclusions locked before unblinding
stages.exit_rule: results are payload-safe, uncertainty-qualified, and separated by language

stages.name: candidate_handoff
stages.exit_rule: explicit maintainer promotion decision remains required for every release change

analyses.question: How many unique usable candidates or synonyms does each authorized source role add beyond the baseline?
analyses.estimand: eligible unique candidates per 100 concept-language-object units after lineage deduplication
analyses.decision_use: prioritize sources for later evaluation, never promote terms

analyses.question: Does independent-lineage support predict panel acceptance better than naive source counts?
analyses.estimand: change in out-of-sample calibration and discrimination for lineage-aware versus naive evidence models
analyses.decision_use: select the evidence aggregation rule for confirmatory study

analyses.question: Which predicate, route, semantic-loss, and rights classes produce useful HPO candidates?
analyses.estimand: acceptance, clinically significant error, and abstention by route class with uncertainty intervals
analyses.decision_use: retain, narrow, or prohibit route classes prospectively

analyses.question: Do source-supported translations preserve discrimination from HPO parents, children, and siblings?
analyses.estimand: hard-negative discrimination accuracy and safety-error rate
analyses.decision_use: identify unsafe semantic patterns and required context

analyses.question: Does exact language-script-region matching reduce disagreement and regional mismatch?
analyses.estimand: difference in regional-mismatch error and edit burden between exact-variant and generic-language evidence
analyses.decision_use: require variant-specific evidence where material; never collapse variants

analyses.question: What is each lineage group's marginal contribution?
analyses.estimand: change in candidate yield, panel acceptance, calibration, and semantic discrimination when a lineage group is removed
analyses.decision_use: remove redundant or harmful sources and avoid false consensus

analyses.question: Can source and HPO change signals predict translations requiring reassessment?
analyses.estimand: precision-recall and calibration for future changed or rejected items under temporal replay

analyses.question: Do accepted candidates improve multilingual HPO extraction or phenotype ranking?
analyses.estimand: task-specific performance difference on public or separately authorized evaluation data
analyses.decision_use: support downstream-utility claims only; not translation validity or clinical effectiveness

decision_rules.source_admission: A source enters empirical analysis only when its exact payload, version, language rendition, route applicability, rights, and purpose are authorized and frozen.
decision_rules.lineage: Count one vote per independent originating evidence group; mirrors, imports, translations copied across editions, and aggregate representations do not create additional votes.
decision_rules.mapping: Only explicit directed predicates may support a candidate; xref, related, compositional, containment, family, edition, and language relationships never become exact equivalence by traversal.
decision_rules.variants: Language, script, region, register, and edition remain separate; generic evidence may be analysed as unresolved but cannot claim exact regional support.
decision_rules.progression: Apply only the prespecified Stage 1 go/revise/stop rule; source performance observed after unblinding cannot redefine that rule.
decision_rules.promotion: No score, majority, source count, route, panel agreement, or downstream benefit authorizes promotion. An accountable maintainer promotion decision is always separate.

contingencies.action: retain metadata-only feasibility result; exclude atoms and candidates; do not substitute a mirror
use the source only for discovery, context, or a prespecified candidate-only mediated route; otherwise record unavailable
collapse to one conservative evidence group
exclude variant-specific claims and analyse only in an explicitly unresolved stratum
keep the frozen run, record drift, and create a new freeze for the new release
step down according to the frozen Option B contingency or remain synthetic-only
publish aggregate payload-safe metrics and provenance identifiers only

required_outputs: concept-language-source atom ledger stored under applicable custody rules
